The Siam Industrial Wire Company Limited (‘ SIW’) is an indirect wholly owned foreign subsidiary of Tata Steel Limited (‘Company’) incorporated in Thailand. text: Sub: News Clarification - "Reliance denies receiving Russian oil at its Jamnagar refinery in recent weeks” We refer to your letter / email dated January 6, 2026 seeking clarification on the news item - “Reliance denies receiving Russian oil at its Jamnagar refinery in recent weeks ”. Bloomberg has updated their news report clarifying that Russia Oil Cargo earlier linked to Reliance discharges elsewhere. text: Sub: Appointment of Senior Management Personnel Ref.: Regulation 30 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations. 2015 (“Listing Regulations”) _________________________________________________________________________ The Board of Directors of the Company , based on the recommendation of the Nomination, Remuneration and Compensation Committee, considered and approved the appointment of Mr. Ashish Chandra as Chief Manufacturing Officer (Designate) of the Company with effect from 16th September, 2026. He will be a Senior Management Personnel from the said date. Mr. E R Raj Narayanan will relinquish his position as the Chief Manufacturing Officer of the Company on 31 st March, 2027, after overseeing a planned transition. Mr. Chandra will take over the role of Chief Manufacturing Officer from 1st April, 2027.
